steps.text: Bring a rope, and an antidote or destroy field runes for the poison fields.
steps.source: Rope. Recommended Antidote, Antidote Rune, or Destroy Field for Poison Fields.

steps.text: Go down into the Ancient Temple north of Thais, two floors.
steps.source: Go to the Ancient Temple, north of Thais (Mapper Coords 126.100, 125.171, 7). Go down two levels.

steps.text: Head as far north as you can and go down two floors to the rotworms.
steps.source: Head as far north as you can go. Go down to the level with the Rotworms.

steps.text: Follow the path east and south and go down the ladder (rotworms, poison spiders, orcs and orc spearmen).
steps.source: Follow this path to the east and south, and go down the ladder.

steps.text: Through the poison fields (antidote or destroy field) and down another level.
steps.source: On this level, there will be a lot of Poison Fields. You can either run through them and then use Antidote, or you can use Destroy Field to clear a path. Go down another level.

steps.text: Follow the path east and north (poison spiders, minotaurs) and go down the hole (cyclopes).
steps.source: Follow this path to the east and north. Be careful of Minotaurs. Go down the hole that is circled on the map. You will face a couple Cyclopes down this hole.

steps.text: Follow this path all the way north and go down.
steps.source: Follow this path all of the way north, and go down a level.

steps.text: Minotaurs, a minotaur archer and a minotaur guard. Work your way south through the room and use your rope here to go up.
steps.source: This room contains a large number of Minotaurs, Minotaur Archers, a Minotaur Mage and a Minotaur Guard. Work your way to the south of this room and go up a level.

steps.text: Follow the passage to the switch. Pulling it moves the wall and traps you with the cyclopes: kill them.
steps.source: Follow the passage until you find the switch. Be careful, when you flip the switch, the wall will be moved, and you will be essentially trapped with the Cyclopes.

steps.text: The small diamond is in this chest.
steps.source: Once you flip the switch, you can get the reward.
